facts.text: The Kummer Vanguard Scholars program selects up to 400 incoming STEM students each year to receive $2,000 annually for up to four years, requiring a 3.4 high school GPA and a 26 ACT or 1240 SAT score for freshman eligibility.

sources.quote: Students from around the world will be selected based on academic and non-academic criteria. Each Kummer Vanguard Scholar will receive between $2,000 a year for up to four years

sources.title: Kummer Vanguard Scholars < Missouri University of Science and Technology
